blocks.html: Geographies covered  Kenya, Egypt, Tanzania

blocks.text: The four cases below cover East and North Africa. Three meet the success criteria: M-KOPA (asset financing), MNT-Halan (digital lending) and NALA (cross-border payments). The fourth, Sendy, a logistics company that closed in 2023, is the cautionary case. Three regional features shape capital strategy: mobile money dominates East African payments, Egypt has absorbed repeated devaluations since 2016, and DFIs are active in both regions.
